Netflix Scammer

By: Sasha Schwendenwein | Paid

Proposal


Show:

Unique Selling Point:
This man has many faces – an events planner, a film director, a medical doctor, a pastor, a gold trader, a Disney and Netflix distributor and now… a drag queen. But who is Stephanus Pieterse? This story is about a men who many say is a con-artist that has scammed them out of their money…but is he just misunderstood and a man of many talents?
We have several strong case studies including his former partner King Ngubane who we can speak with. All willing to go on camera, however AB is in cape town. Alethea I have an interview with.
We have an opportunity to catch him finally after a year of looking for him in Krugersdorp - we have sent someone in undercover and they will direct us and help us catch him.

Summary:
AB Pieters
Mindpath (Netflix)
Handlesmerk (Kyknet)
Lammie Beaukes (Kyknet)
AB Pieters: Stef was referred to AB by another colleague - he was looking for a producer to help film a show. AB told him he was an EP, not a producer, and asked him how far his skills stretched – Stef said he was a Director, Writer and registered with the south african writers guild and in the process of becoming a netflix agent. AB says he proved to have the skills as writer, director, producer and a vast network within the industry. AB paid Stef upfront to shoot a pilot. AB paid for groceries and a new laptop and phone. He said it had been approved by Netflix and Multichoice, but then there were constant delays in the process. Cast and crew also said Stef hadn’t paid them. Eventually he admitted it had all been lies and he had taken the money to pay debts. AB introduced Alethea to Stef. Stef filmed his pilots and confirmed with him that Netflix had commissioned his show Mind Path for Netflix, Handelsmerk for Kyknett as well as Lammie Beukes for Kyknet. He paid Stef over R100 000. Never saw the pilot he said he made for AB. Stef sent AB messages he said came from Karen Meiring who is retired and has no idea who this man is. There was also a "contract" that Stef said came from Karen Meiring. Used all his savings on what he thought was a deal from Netflix and two deals from Multichoice.
Alethea Volanie
Woman In Film: love is not enough
Alethea Volanie: Received a letter of Intent from Women in Film (WIF) but WIF said it did not come from them and they had never heard of Stef.
Quit her job because she thought she got a deal of R24,000
Denzil Booysen
Netflix
Made a pilot with him as a director
Denzil Booysen: Met SP on Facebook when he was looking for a writer on his pilot, shot in Venda. The whole series was commissioned, and he asked SP to work on it. He had to pay SP’s transport because he claimed he was out of money. SP claimed daily that he was speaking to a Netflix commissioner and had voice notes from the supposed commissioner – actually from a partner in crime?? He said he would sell the series in 95 countries if Netflix didn’t take it. He increased the rates for the actors without asking Denzil, and promised payment which never arrived. He took all the footage away to edit it, but it never materialised and he claimed there were problems with audio etc. On the day before cast and crew payments were due he left all the FB and Whatsapp groups, and changed his cellphone number. Cases were opened for amounts totalling R600 000 owed by the production. Denzil introduced Stef to AB, wanting to help AB to get his productions out. Denzil spent over R70,000 on pilots also the same way I and the rest of the producers have lost monies. Denzil only found out afterwards that he was also scammed Another actor: KENANI SHUNGUBE
https://gaenor.co.za/artists/kenani-shungube/

Heinrich Nell (Elaine Nell)
Ruined the Nell family
Pastor
Medical Doctor
Nell Brothers – Elaine is a widow. Pieterse took advantage of her due to her connection with him via Shekina Endoxos Ministries. A post on SoundCloud show a Heinrich Nell accusing Pieterse (AKA Marks) of scamming vulnerable widows. https://soundcloud.com/apos-stephan-pieterse/tracks Heinrich will speak Spoke to Emile Nell, Elaine Nell (079 503 4097) son: Brothers Heinrich (don’t mention where the numbers came from – 082 087 0125, 082 623 8667) and Rudi Nell 083 790 1107.
Before his father died, Steven Pieterse pitched up. His father passed away. His mom elaine was left with a lot of cash – she’s very – he was sick with cancer – his stomach was bloated. Medical stuff – no money. He lived in Randfontein at a stage. His mom Elaine went to go look after his wife and kids. The brother and him started realizing… mother was asking for more and more – no more for this guy… she had an allowance. She’s not capable of manging money… she was naïve. They were very poor – had not food etc…
He had cancer, then he had chemo and radiation… both at the same time… “pancreatic cancer”… Want a full doctors note on him and diagnosis etc… then he got healed (Christian). This carried on for about a year. His mom started sneaking money out for this guy, Emile realized the money is going to this guy. This caused a big rupture over this. The brothers had a fall out etc The next thing, his mom elaine signed over the account to be administered by herself… estate… They relinquished everything. This guy is going to take you for everything you had… don’t know how much he took. They lost contact. They promised their father to take care of her. Rudi and Emile said they are done…2-3 years ago…
He claimed to be a medical doctor… Wendy hut in Randfontein…Elaine’s old house was mimosa street in Helderfontein… They were filming in her house… a film crew… (before covid around 2018/9)




Further information:
Psychologist – to speak about the psychology behind this man – he doesn’t seem very attractive or very intelligent, yet he has conned more than 15 people. He’s a narcissist – takes someone special to go after a widow, and people who are desperate for fame.

Extra Budget Items:
Might to film some case studies in cape town, and east london.

Script:


3 seconds of images before VO


Breathe


Stef upsound: Good afternoon everybody


A recorded message from the set of a 2019 horror movie, Exodus, by the film’s acclaimed Director, Stephanus Pieterse…


Stef upsound: so this little video we made in order for me to get an opportunity to speak to you all, to say many things that I might not have the opportunity to say later…


Breathe


A man of many faces and talents, he was known to his film crew simply as Stef.


AB: I thought he was the most talented person on this planet


A serial name-dropper, Stef claimed he’d studied at famous film schools… and now worked for global television networks.


Denzil: He was always speaking with people on the phone just to just to put us on the idea that he is speaking with industry gurus.


… and when not on the phone, he was rubbing shoulders with royalty


…as a Director..

Director: I will probably see you again or I wont because you’ll be in LA.


An actor…

Actor: Elke keer as jy my sien soek jy tee - lyk ek is soos ‘n teepot?

and even a pastor!

Pastor: We will pray for you and we will take everything personally


DIP TO BLACK END OF OPENING SEQUENCE

Stef Pieterse - or whatever name he happens to be going by - is a master of reinvention. In a tough local film industry, it’s likely why so many people bought into his promises of fame and fortune.


Since childhood Denzil Booysens only ever wanted to act

Denzil: He introduce himself by saying he's a producer and a writer. In this industry when you start you are hungry for this people.


Stef contacted Denzil on Facebook in 2019, with the offer of a lifetime:

A starring role in Stef’s next film: Exodus.

photos of film / VIDEO OF FILM…

Denzil: Exodus was about a character who killed who killed people who sinned.

The film’s location, Gqeberha, was abuzz and the media clamoured for interviews with its famous director.

RADIO INTERVIEW:
Radio host: Welcome Stef Pieterse he is a movie director, and has been making films for 20 years.


Stef:, i wanted to be a medical doctor, I ended up going to film school instead, and i write stories and make them and I give ppl the opportunity to live in a world I can create.



Producing films isn’t cheap - and with a crew of up to 30 people, the bills soon piled up. Denzil says Stef persuaded him to become a financial backer in exchange for a producer credit.

Denzil: I spent approximately between hundred and hundred and twenty thousand rand on this film.

The film wrapped just days before Christmas… but the film’s Director had “cut” and run!

Denzil: When he left all of a sudden his phone was off…. Everyone came back to me because they want to get paid.

Denzil was left red-faced and out of pocket.

END OF ACT 1 – TC: 03 46
LOURENSA: LINK: OFTEN IT’S HARD TO KNOW WHAT IS GOING ON IN THE MIND OF SOMEONE ACCUSED OF FRAUD OR THEFT, BUT THIS TIME WE GOT TO KNOW THE MAN BEHIND STEF, WHO KNEW HIM BEST, HIS FORMER BUSINESS PARTNER AND... BOYFRIEND…


King: I fell in love with the guy um instantly, he was the sweetest guy ever and everything was perfect.

Emerging from the wilderness of the Exodus fiasco, Stef appeared ready for love: he used Facebook to contact and woo King Ngubeni, and, just months later the two moved in together.

they would go on to launch a production and distribution company called Ngubeni Media.


Stef claimed a senior Kyknet exec among his personal friends, and said he could open doors at the streaming service, Netflix.


Namibian producer, AB Pieters, became a marquee client.
AB: oh my word I thought he was the most talented person on this planet he studied at New York Film Academy um he had lawyers he had accountants he had a team.
AB contracted Stef to produce 3 series pilot episodes - one for Netflix and two for Kyknet. It would cost more than R100 000.
Lourensa: What were some of the promises that he made to you?

AB: That I got a deal with Netflix, kyk Net, with Multi Choice, and not only that I also was furnished a contract for multi choice and the contract from Netflix as well.

(PAUSE & FIX GRAPHICS: fake netflix, kyknet, multichoice letters)

Lourensa: So he showed you these emails from these channels saying we need a pilot and that's the excuse he used to get you to pay money to film these pilots?

AB: Exactly, my first pilot was 50,000 rand, I paid him cash.

Make upsound here from his show (i think we need this to be longer)

With his pilots in production, AB introduced Stef to emerging script writer, Alethea Volanie. She’d used her time in Covid lockdown to write a romance for the silver screen.
Alethea: Steph said look I can help you. Next I started getting um an email from Steph saying listen that proposal you shared with me there’s this company in LA and they show interest in helping you they called Women In Film.
It was the break she’d been dreaming of: Women in Film “apparently” offered a R2-million contract on condition that Stef produced a short teaser for the film - for the comparatively smaller sum of R24,000.

(fake WIF letter)

She paid and production began…
SOUNDUP OF HER FILM…

According to AB and Alethea, Stef was ever the busy film bigwig, often unavailable because he was taking important calls from Netflix execs.

…but his partner knew better.

King. And now when I look at it I see that he was basically speaking to no one on the phone he's just pretending.

NEEDS DRAMATIC PAUSE

Eventually, Alethea’s suspicions got the better of her.
Alethea: It's just that intuition, something is just not sitting well with me, and then I phoned Woman in Film, and they said no that’s not true.
Devastatingly, the LA production house knew nothing about Alethea’s film.
NEEDS DRAMATIC PAUSE
And, it turned out all the contracts AB had signed, as well as Stef’s certification as a Netflix distributor, were just as fake.
It was around this time that our own investigation into the mysterious film mogul got underway: Stef’s victims had been struggling to track him down despite how industrious he was on social media.

We uncovered Stef the Doctor…
UPS
…As well as the Apostle Stephan who shared profound insights like,“Don’t be deceived by Beauty, a golden snake is still a snake…”

And his spiritual guidance continues…

Apostle stef: Humanity is more interested in what you have done, rather than what you are doing…

We also found his impressive movie resume - which was completely fake.

Netflix confirmed they’re not associated with Stef in any way - and had sent him this cease and desist letter.

We couldn’t find a single local channel that had ever worked with him.

Then, last year, Stef appeared to vanish from social media …

only to reappear as another alter ego - or two, to be more precise: the drag personas: Mimi Wylde and Tante Alie…

Videos of stef as mimi/tante alie

PAUSE

LINK: SOME SAY HE IS A CON-ARTIST THAT HAS SCAMMED THEM OUT OF THEIR MONEY…BUT IS HE JUST MISUNDERSTOOD AND A MAN OF MANY TALENTS?
Fade up from black

After months of searching, we tracked Stef down at a house on Joburg’s West Rand…

LINK: SO WE’VE COME TO THIS HOUSE, WE’VE SPOKEN TO THE OWNER WHO SAID HE’S GONE TO FETCH HIM…

Lourensa: Stef How are you? We are from Carte Blanche, my name is Lourensa
Nice to meet you?
Stef: Hi.
Lourensa: We wanted to know why did you steal all that money from ppl in the film industry?
Stef: I didn’t steal any money.
Lourensa: But you pretended to be a distributor for netflix, kyknet, women in film?
Stef: No.
Lourensa: You didn’t pretend to do that?
Stef: No.
Lourensa: You never forged documents?
Stef: No I didn’t.

Surprisingly, Stef welcomed the chance to unburden himself.

Lourensa: Wat sal jy sê vir iemand wat sê jy is 'n serial scammer?
Stef: Maybe not seriel .. Ek het dit net een keer gedoen..


But his epiphany was short-lived.

Lourensa: Wat is jou agtergrond?
Stef: Kyk ek het opleiding gekry die by die LA FILM ACADEMY

Really?

Lourensa: So was jy daar, of nie? Jy kan eerlik wees.
Stef: ja ok, ek was nie daar nie
Lourensa: was jy by die NEW YORK FILM ACADEMY?
Stef: Nee
Lourensa: ook nie, maar jy het vir mense gese jy was?
Stef: Ja
Lourensa: Hoekom het jy dit gedoen?
Stef: Kyk die mense van wie jy praat, het gekry waarvoor hulle gevra het. of waarvoor hulle betaal het. Niemands se geld was gesteel nie.

But did they get value for money?

Stef: Ek het nie voorgegee om 'n distributor te wees of 'n agent te wees of watookal nie..
Lourensa: Maar ek het die brief gesien, Stef ...Maar op grond - wie se ek het die brief geskryf?
Jou handtekening is op die brief - jou naam is op die brief? Jy dink nie dat dit 'n vals indruk kan skep nie?
Stef: ok - ja dit kan…
Lourensa: You went to a lot of trouble to forge it, Stef?
Stef: Well, if you do these kind of things, surely you have to be convincing?
Stef: I knew it was illegal, I knew it was fraud. If you’re depserate you do what you have to.


And so, finally, the truth.
Lourensa: Many people in this country are desperate, Stef. They don’t do what you did.
Stef: I think many people in this country do what i do, but they’re don’t get caught.


fade to black

ENDING….]


Stef’s crisis of conscience will come as little consolation to his victims who, as they say in the movies, are this story’s fall guys.

END OF ACT 1 – TC: 03 46 LOURENSA: LINK: OFTEN IT’S HARD TO KNOW WHAT IS GOING ON IN THE MIND OF SOMEONE ACCUSED OF FRAUD OR THEFT, BUT THIS TIME WE GOT TO KNOW THE MAN BEHIND STEF, WHO KNEW HIM BEST, HIS FORMER BUSINESS PARTNER AND... BOYFRIEND… King: I fell in love with the guy um instantly, he was the sweetest guy ever and everything was perfect. Emerging from the wilderness of the Exodus fiasco, Stef appeared ready for love: he used Facebook to contact and woo King Ngubeni, and, just months later the two moved in together. they would go on to launch a production and distribution company called Ngubeni Media. Stef claimed a senior Kyknet exec among his personal friends, and said he could open doors at the streaming service, Netflix. Namibian producer, AB Pieters, became a marquee client. AB: oh my word I thought he was the most talented person on this planet he studied at New York Film Academy um he had lawyers he had accountants he had a team. AB contracted Stef to produce 3 series pilot episodes - one for Netflix and two for Kyknet. It would cost more than R100 000. Lourensa: What were some of the promises that he made to you? AB: That I got a deal with Netflix, kyk Net, with Multi Choice, and not only that I also was furnished a contract for multi choice and the contract from Netflix as well. (PAUSE & FIX GRAPHICS: fake netflix, kyknet, multichoice letters) Lourensa: So he showed you these emails from these channels saying we need a pilot and that's the excuse he used to get you to pay money to film these pilots? AB: Exactly, my first pilot was 50,000 rand, I paid him cash. Make upsound here from his show (i think we need this to be longer) With his pilots in production, AB introduced Stef to emerging script writer, Alethea Volanie. She’d used her time in Covid lockdown to write a romance for the silver screen. Alethea: Steph said look I can help you. Next I started getting um an email from Steph saying listen that proposal you shared with me there’s this company in LA and they show interest in helping you they called Women In Film. It was the break she’d been dreaming of: Women in Film “apparently” offered a R2-million contract on condition that Stef produced a short teaser for the film - for the comparatively smaller sum of R24,000. (fake WIF letter) She paid and production began… SOUNDUP OF HER FILM… According to AB and Alethea, Stef was ever the busy film bigwig, often unavailable because he was taking important calls from Netflix execs. …but his partner knew better. King. And now when I look at it I see that he was basically speaking to no one on the phone he's just pretending. NEEDS DRAMATIC PAUSE Eventually, Alethea’s suspicions got the better of her. Alethea: It's just that intuition, something is just not sitting well with me, and then I phoned Woman in Film, and they said no that’s not true. Devastatingly, the LA production house knew nothing about Alethea’s film. NEEDS DRAMATIC PAUSE And, it turned out all the contracts AB had signed, as well as Stef’s certification as a Netflix distributor, were just as fake. It was around this time that our own investigation into the mysterious film mogul got underway: Stef’s victims had been struggling to track him down despite how industrious he was on social media. We uncovered Stef the Doctor… UPS …As well as the Apostle Stephan who shared profound insights like,“Don’t be deceived by Beauty, a golden snake is still a snake…” And his spiritual guidance continues… Apostle stef: Humanity is more interested in what you have done, rather than what you are doing… We also found his impressive movie resume - which was completely fake. Netflix confirmed they’re not associated with Stef in any way - and had sent him this cease and desist letter. We couldn’t find a single local channel that had ever worked with him. Then, last year, Stef appeared to vanish from social media … only to reappear as another alter ego - or two, to be more precise: the drag personas: Mimi Wylde and Tante Alie… Videos of stef as mimi/tante alie PAUSE LINK: SOME SAY HE IS A CON-ARTIST THAT HAS SCAMMED THEM OUT OF THEIR MONEY…BUT IS HE JUST MISUNDERSTOOD AND A MAN OF MANY TALENTS? Fade up from black After months of searching, we tracked Stef down at a house on Joburg’s West Rand… LINK: SO WE’VE COME TO THIS HOUSE, WE’VE SPOKEN TO THE OWNER WHO SAID HE’S GONE TO FETCH HIM… Lourensa: Stef How are you? We are from Carte Blanche, my name is Lourensa Nice to meet you? Stef: Hi. Lourensa: We wanted to know why did you steal all that money from ppl in the film industry? Stef: I didn’t steal any money. Lourensa: But you pretended to be a distributor for netflix, kyknet, women in film? Stef: No. Lourensa: You didn’t pretend to do that? Stef: No. Lourensa: You never forged documents? Stef: No I didn’t. Surprisingly, Stef welcomed the chance to unburden himself. Lourensa: Wat sal jy sê vir iemand wat sê jy is 'n serial scammer? Stef: Maybe not seriel .. Ek het dit net een keer gedoen.. But his epiphany was short-lived. Lourensa: Wat is jou agtergrond? Stef: Kyk ek het opleiding gekry die by die LA FILM ACADEMY Really? Lourensa: So was jy daar, of nie? Jy kan eerlik wees. Stef: ja ok, ek was nie daar nie Lourensa: was jy by die NEW YORK FILM ACADEMY? Stef: Nee Lourensa: ook nie, maar jy het vir mense gese jy was? Stef: Ja Lourensa: Hoekom het jy dit gedoen? Stef: Kyk die mense van wie jy praat, het gekry waarvoor hulle gevra het. of waarvoor hulle betaal het. Niemands se geld was gesteel nie. But did they get value for money? Stef: Ek het nie voorgegee om 'n distributor te wees of 'n agent te wees of watookal nie.. Lourensa: Maar ek het die brief gesien, Stef ...Maar op grond - wie se ek het die brief geskryf? Jou handtekening is op die brief - jou naam is op die brief? Jy dink nie dat dit 'n vals indruk kan skep nie? Stef: ok - ja dit kan… Lourensa: You went to a lot of trouble to forge it, Stef? Stef: Well, if you do these kind of things, surely you have to be convincing? Stef: I knew it was illegal, I knew it was fraud. If you’re depserate you do what you have to. And so, finally, the truth. Lourensa: Many people in this country are desperate, Stef. They don’t do what you did. Stef: I think many people in this country do what i do, but they’re don’t get caught. fade to black ENDING….] Stef’s crisis of conscience will come as little consolation to his victims who, as they say in the movies, are this story’s fall guys. metadata.Unique Selling Point: This man has many faces – an events planner, a film director, a medical doctor, a pastor, a gold trader, a Disney and Netflix distributor and now… a drag queen. But who is Stephanus Pieterse? This story is about a men who many say is a con-artist that has scammed them out of their money…but is he just misunderstood and a man of many talents? We have several strong case studies including his former partner King Ngubane who we can speak with. All willing to go on camera, however AB is in cape town. Alethea I have an interview with. We have an opportunity to catch him finally after a year of looking for him in Krugersdorp - we have sent someone in undercover and they will direct us and help us catch him.
metadata.Summary: AB Pieters Mindpath (Netflix) Handlesmerk (Kyknet) Lammie Beaukes (Kyknet) AB Pieters: Stef was referred to AB by another colleague - he was looking for a producer to help film a show. AB told him he was an EP, not a producer, and asked him how far his skills stretched – Stef said he was a Director, Writer and registered with the south african writers guild and in the process of becoming a netflix agent. AB says he proved to have the skills as writer, director, producer and a vast network within the industry. AB paid Stef upfront to shoot a pilot. AB paid for groceries and a new laptop and phone. He said it had been approved by Netflix and Multichoice, but then there were constant delays in the process. Cast and crew also said Stef hadn’t paid them. Eventually he admitted it had all been lies and he had taken the money to pay debts. AB introduced Alethea to Stef. Stef filmed his pilots and confirmed with him that Netflix had commissioned his show Mind Path for Netflix, Handelsmerk for Kyknett as well as Lammie Beukes for Kyknet. He paid Stef over R100 000. Never saw the pilot he said he made for AB. Stef sent AB messages he said came from Karen Meiring who is retired and has no idea who this man is. There was also a "contract" that Stef said came from Karen Meiring. Used all his savings on what he thought was a deal from Netflix and two deals from Multichoice. Alethea Volanie Woman In Film: love is not enough Alethea Volanie: Received a letter of Intent from Women in Film (WIF) but WIF said it did not come from them and they had never heard of Stef. Quit her job because she thought she got a deal of R24,000 Denzil Booysen Netflix Made a pilot with him as a director Denzil Booysen: Met SP on Facebook when he was looking for a writer on his pilot, shot in Venda. The whole series was commissioned, and he asked SP to work on it. He had to pay SP’s transport because he claimed he was out of money. SP claimed daily that he was speaking to a Netflix commissioner and had voice notes from the supposed commissioner – actually from a partner in crime?? He said he would sell the series in 95 countries if Netflix didn’t take it. He increased the rates for the actors without asking Denzil, and promised payment which never arrived. He took all the footage away to edit it, but it never materialised and he claimed there were problems with audio etc. On the day before cast and crew payments were due he left all the FB and Whatsapp groups, and changed his cellphone number. Cases were opened for amounts totalling R600 000 owed by the production. Denzil introduced Stef to AB, wanting to help AB to get his productions out. Denzil spent over R70,000 on pilots also the same way I and the rest of the producers have lost monies. Denzil only found out afterwards that he was also scammed Another actor: KENANI SHUNGUBE https://gaenor.co.za/artists/kenani-shungube/ Heinrich Nell (Elaine Nell) Ruined the Nell family Pastor Medical Doctor Nell Brothers – Elaine is a widow. Pieterse took advantage of her due to her connection with him via Shekina Endoxos Ministries. A post on SoundCloud show a Heinrich Nell accusing Pieterse (AKA Marks) of scamming vulnerable widows. https://soundcloud.com/apos-stephan-pieterse/tracks Heinrich will speak Spoke to Emile Nell, Elaine Nell (079 503 4097) son: Brothers Heinrich (don’t mention where the numbers came from – 082 087 0125, 082 623 8667) and Rudi Nell 083 790 1107. Before his father died, Steven Pieterse pitched up. His father passed away. His mom elaine was left with a lot of cash – she’s very – he was sick with cancer – his stomach was bloated. Medical stuff – no money. He lived in Randfontein at a stage. His mom Elaine went to go look after his wife and kids. The brother and him started realizing… mother was asking for more and more – no more for this guy… she had an allowance. She’s not capable of manging money… she was naïve. They were very poor – had not food etc… He had cancer, then he had chemo and radiation… both at the same time… “pancreatic cancer”… Want a full doctors note on him and diagnosis etc… then he got healed (Christian). This carried on for about a year. His mom started sneaking money out for this guy, Emile realized the money is going to this guy. This caused a big rupture over this. The brothers had a fall out etc The next thing, his mom elaine signed over the account to be administered by herself… estate… They relinquished everything. This guy is going to take you for everything you had… don’t know how much he took. They lost contact. They promised their father to take care of her. Rudi and Emile said they are done…2-3 years ago… He claimed to be a medical doctor… Wendy hut in Randfontein…Elaine’s old house was mimosa street in Helderfontein… They were filming in her house… a film crew… (before covid around 2018/9)
metadata.Further information: Psychologist – to speak about the psychology behind this man – he doesn’t seem very attractive or very intelligent, yet he has conned more than 15 people. He’s a narcissist – takes someone special to go after a widow, and people who are desperate for fame.
